chunks: Rejoicing at what their Lord has given them; and their Lord will preserve them from the torment of Hell.
ai.seo_question: How are the righteous described in terms of their joy and protection in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mursalat (77:46) underscores the dual nature of divine favor: the positive bestowal of joy (Fakin) and the negative removal of suffering (Waqa). The term 'Fakin' is often interpreted not merely as eating fruit, but as a state of spiritual contentment and readiness, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the inner tranquility of the righteous who are preserved from the Fire through God's mercy and their own faith.
